simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֹהַב (H159) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֹהַב (ʼôhab) means love. First listed occurrence: Prov 7 18.

definitions.full: H159. ohab [ אֹ֫הַב ] noun [masculine] id. = loved object, suffix אָהֳבָם Hosea 9:10 (= בּשֶׁת = בַּעַל see Hi Now) i.e. the idol worshipped; plural = amours (carnal sense) Prov 7:18 .
